title: Aerial Photoluminescence Imaging of Photovoltaic Modules
mechanism: Hexacopter with an illumination unit and NIR camera images PL of modules at night, without electrical contact.
evidence: R: cracks and PID identified with high confidence, verified against indoor EL; works with up to 50 % excitation non-uniformity; 13.6 modules / min, 300 / min feasible.
adaptation: Same role as drone EL; PL without contact in principle separates isolated (inactive) area from dark material, a possible label source for inactive (S).
min_experiment: No hardware; record as future work. If a PL set becomes available, score the EL model on PL cells for crack relF1@2.
prior_overlap: Desk study ideas T31 (EL / PL contrast) listed, not run.
